modules.title: Plugin 怎样把 AI 能力接进编辑器

items.title: 提供编辑器入口
items.text: 插件可以提供侧边栏、快捷键、行内建议和配置界面。

items.title: 收集当前上下文
items.text: 用户选中代码后，插件可以把文件和语言等上下文发给模型，并在编辑器里展示结果。

items.title: 让修改可预览
items.text: 代码 diff 预览让用户先比较修改，再决定是否接受写回文件。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Plugin 是可安装的软件组件，Skill 是可复用的任务方法，Hook 是事件触发的后台命令。插件改善交互和集成，不保证模型生成的代码没有 Bug。

lessonPractice.title: 团队需要编辑器侧边栏和 diff 预览，哪种扩展更匹配？

options.label: 使用 Plugin，把界面入口和编辑器集成打包进去
options.feedback: 对。Plugin 适合提供侧边栏、快捷键、行内建议和 diff 等编辑器能力。

options.label: 使用 Skill，因为 Skill 会自动提供跨编辑器的可视化界面
options.feedback: Skill 主要提供可复用的任务方法和文件，不等于编辑器 UI 扩展。

options.label: 使用 Hook，因为后台事件脚本会自动生成完整的侧边栏
options.feedback: Hook 监听事件并执行预设任务，不负责提供编辑器侧边栏或 diff 界面。

en.title: A team needs an editor sidebar and diff preview. Which extension fits?

options.label: Use a Plugin to package the UI entry point and editor integration
options.feedback: Correct. Plugins can provide sidebars, shortcuts, inline suggestions, and diff views in an editor.

options.label: Use a Skill because Skills automatically provide visual UI across editors
options.feedback: A Skill mainly provides a reusable task method and files; it is not an editor UI extension.

options.label: Use a Hook because a background event script will create the full sidebar
options.feedback: A Hook listens for events and runs preset tasks; it does not provide a sidebar or diff interface.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先判断这个需求是编辑器界面集成、可复用任务流程，还是事件后自动检查；只有需要侧边栏、快捷键或 diff 预览时才设计 Plugin。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: First classify this need as editor integration, a reusable task workflow, or an event-triggered check. Design a Plugin only if it needs a sidebar, shortcuts, or a diff preview.

learning.assumes: You have used a code editor and seen a sidebar or code-completion extension.
learning.outcome: You can choose between a Plugin, Skill, and Hook and know that a plugin cannot guarantee correct generated code.

modules.title: How does a Plugin bring AI into an editor?

items.title: Provide an editor entry point
items.text: A plugin can add a sidebar, shortcuts, inline suggestions, or a configuration panel.

items.title: Collect current context
items.text: After a selection, it can send file and language context to the model and show the result in the editor.

items.title: Make changes reviewable
items.text: A side-by-side diff lets the user compare a proposal before accepting it into the file.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A Plugin is installable software, a Skill is a reusable task method, and a Hook is an event-triggered background command. A plugin improves integration but cannot guarantee bug-free output.

distinctions.label: Agent Skill
distinctions.text: A {c:plugin} packages code to extend the host application's UI, commands, or runtime; a {c:skill} instructs an AI agent with domain workflows, scripts, and guidelines.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: First classify this need as editor integration, a reusable task workflow, or an event-triggered check. Design a Plugin only if it needs a sidebar, shortcuts, or a diff preview.
